:::{#exr-matrix-of-linear-map-practice}
#### Finding the matrix of a linear map into $\reals^3$

The [matrix of a linear map](#def-matrix-of-linear-map) turns the map into a table of numbers
that software can store and multiply.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^3$ be the [linear map](#def-linear-map)

$$
f(\vx) = (x_2,\ x_1,\ x_1 - x_2).
$$

Find the [matrix of $f$](#def-matrix-of-linear-map).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

[Column $j$ of the matrix](#def-matrix-column) is $f(\vecf{e}_j)$.

:::

:::
